title: Concept: Upstash Redis REST token in a response
description: An Upstash REST endpoint with a bearer token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The token authorises arbitrary commands against the rate-limit or session store, so an attacker can flush a cache, reset a counter or read another tenant's keys.
applicability: Deployments that render an Upstash REST endpoint with a bearer token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The token authorises arbitrary commands against the rate-limit or session store, so an attacker can flush a cache, reset a counter or read another tenant's keys.
